crossRefs.note: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.
“Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
“Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

translations.web: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
translations.bsb: If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage; but if you scoff, you alone will bear the consequences.
